title: Retail Installment Contracts Borrower Terms: Autopay Relief on Late Charges
content:
A borrower who pays a contract under Retail Installment Contracts by recurring autopay receives an autopay reduction on a late charge, set by the payments posted through recurring autopay on the contract in the rolling 12 months, whether or not any of them was later returned.

**Terms.**

- With at least **9** autopay payments posted in the rolling 12 months, the autopay reduction is **20 percent**.
- With at least **6** but fewer than **9**, it is **10 percent**.
- With fewer than **6**, there is no autopay reduction.

Only payments drawn by the borrower's recurring automatic draft count. A one-time bank draft or a card payment, even one made by phone or online, is not an autopay payment. The rolling 12 months are counted from records dated later than the same calendar day 12 months before the assessment date (the last day of that month when that day does not exist) through the assessment date.

| Autopay payments posted (returned or not) | Autopay reduction |
|---|---|
| 0 to 5 | none |
| 6 | 10 percent |
| 8 | 10 percent |
| 9 | 20 percent |
| 12 | 20 percent |

**Hypothetical history.** Eight autopay drafts posted in the window, one of which the bank returned, and three one-time card payments: the eight drafts count (the returned one included) and the card payments do not, so the reduction is 10 percent. A ninth autopay draft in the window would lift it to 20 percent.
